headline: Microsoft plans to let Microsoft 365 Family and Premium subscribers share their Copilot AI benefits, Neowin reports.
score_reason: Pool 5 kept: a plain consumer-plan change, but only the headline could be checked, so details such as who can share and when are unknown.
importance_line: Households on Microsoft 365 Family and Premium plans may soon get more from Copilot, but the terms and the date are not yet known to us.
summary: Neowin reports that Microsoft 365 Family and Premium subscribers will soon be able to share their Copilot AI benefits.
